{{Quote|I ''outnumbered'', I all the way ''surrounded''&ndash; and ''I'' about to win ''victory''!'' Ha Ha Ha''!|Xerius Ugg|<ref name="The Clone Wars 1">[[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Xerius Ugg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I will&hellip;never..tell you&hellip; where you'll find.... people|Ugg's final words|<ref name="The Clone Wars 1" />}}
Xerius Ugg led the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|army]] on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] and set a trap for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task force that arrived to liberate the world. Though his forces were decimated, he demanded to see [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to demand his army's surrender, for he planted thermal bombs around the capital city. Obi-Wan tried to be diplomatic, for he couldn't surrender until he was sure the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] were safe. But Ugg was impatient and the negotiations turned into ''aggressive'' hand-to-hand combat. But while he fought with Kenobi, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] went around defusing all the bombs. Eventually, a droid came to him personally and told him what was going on. Frantic, he tried to hit the detonator but only one bomb went off&mdash;right at his escape ship. Kenobi then took advantage of the distraction to throw him from the top of the command center. At the bottom, Kenobi once again asked where the Togruta were but Ugg refused to tell before dying.

==Behind the scenes==
Ugg's first name, Xerius, was not revealed until the introduction in the [[The Clone Wars 2|second issue]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Slaves of the Republic|''Slaves of the Republic'']].

The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|Clone Wars animated series]] featured an animated version of the Battle of Kiros in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|season four]] episode ''[[Kidnapped]]'' but it featured a number of differences, the most notable being the replacement of Ugg with another [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] commander, a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] by the name of [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]].
